# Shibumi 0.1.1-beta.14

## Summary

Beta.14 keeps the 24-plugin, 18-owner, one-Quickshell-process architecture and
the Omarchy 4.0.3 host baseline. It stabilizes scoped widget loading and hardens
bar handoffs. Top-level widgets return after complete output loss without a
recovery rescan.

The release also eliminates Network telemetry binding loops and binds package
admission and release evidence to exact payload identities.

## Included

- Current-registry Loader admission with native Component and exact provenance
  checks
- One process-bound startup registry prime, without an output-recovery rescan,
  recovery poller, or additional process
- Guarded hosted-widget popout release during live removal, addressing #51
- Exact Beta.13 predecessor identities and bounded, redaction-safe diagnostics,
  addressing #53
- Network telemetry demand derived without reading back projected connection
  state
- Scoped Quick Access presentation and output ownership
- Reproducible release archive with fail-closed package admission

## Validation

The complete source gates and all four pinned host-compatibility gates passed
during candidate validation. The affected Network regressions and final hosted
package-contract job also passed after the Network correction.

One physical DisplayPort hot-unplug and replug cycle on the pre-final `4d9744c`
candidate restored all 16 top-level slots on single-output `DP-1` without a
recovery rescan. The exact final plugin payload completed a 30-minute live
window covering all V1/V2 presentations, five G4 toggles, workspace style,
Wi-Fi off/on, lock/unlock, and third-party plugin removal. The scoped log diff
contained no binding-loop or `TypeError` match, no Shibumi-attributed
`WARN scene` match, and no `ERROR` match.

The reproducible release archive contains 412 files:

`63630a499d6c793ef7c7a8b2f1475de6deea675cc3b820a904ca0031ec544279`

## Known limits

- Reporter confirmation for #54 remains pending. The physical output-return
  evidence applies only to the pre-final `4d9744c` candidate.
- The embedded G3 status-composite children did not return with their outer
  top-level slot and remain a separate finding.
- Unattributed `QQmlVMEMetaObject` invalid-context warnings occurred during
  output return and live third-party removal without observed functional loss.
- Source checkouts installed between tagged releases must be uninstalled with
  `--keep-settings` from their exact commit before installing a newer checkout.
- Physical multi-output, HDMI, reporter hardware, and real power-button
  acceptance were unavailable.
- AUR publication remains deferred.
